Introduction

JAESSBEE is a South Korean project group featuring JAEJAE, Gabee, and Seungheon. The group was formed through the popular YouTube variety show MMTG's content 'Great Jatsby'. They debuted on November 11, 2024, with the single "Every Moment with You".
